title: Run and publish the initial experimental sequence
description:
## Scope

Execute documented smoke checks, a Jev selection/size study, Jev ordering sensitivity, and then the eligible cross-model matrix. Keep lab notes and articles attached to actual measured results.

## Definition of done

Every frozen eligible cell is accounted for, conclusions distinguish exploratory and confirmatory analyses, and reports reproduce offline from approved text-free results.

**Owner redirect, 2026-10-01.** Priorities moved to the Unified Decision Flywheel: initiative `decision-flywheel-evaluations-258cd418-2a73-447b-9c78-5073fbf42959`, design `studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md`. The large static Jev selection-by-size study is complete and published: `studies/INITIAL_JEV_RESULTS.md` (commits 44e14e1, 7068ded). Demonstration-ordering and Jev/Kev/Laya cross-model comparisons are **deferred, not cancelled** (Laya and Kev cannot take few-shot context). No spend is approved for this work.

The initial Jev selection-by-size study is closed as done. The ordering run, the Jev/Kev/Laya matrix and the Kev/Laya half of the capability pilot are in backlog; the reporting task keeps one open item (a recorded offline replay). Epic stays open at low priority.
